metadata.question: In the Norwegian Sea during Septermber 19, 2019, is the water color at (46.694935, -50.925784) more milky than (46.809436, -58.528990)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (MSI) for water color analysis - Date: September 19, 2019 - Location: Two points in coordinates (46.694935, -50.925784) and (46.809436, -58.528990) - Need RGB or water color indicators 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want to see actual water color - Use QA60 band for cloud masking in Sentinel-2 3. Logic: - "Milky" water typically means higher turbidity/sediment, which appears lighter/whiter in true color - Can use brightness or whiteness index from RGB bands - Valid zero (clear dark water) vs Null (no data after masking) are different - Need to compare brightness/whiteness between two points - A valid comparison needs data at both points 4. Approach: - Get Sentinel-2 images for Sept 19, 2019 - Apply cloud masking - Calculate brightness/whiteness metric (e.g., mean of RGB or a whiteness index) - Compare the two points - Point 1 more milky = higher brightness = Answer A - Point 2 more milky or equal = Answer B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the two points const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-50.925784, 46.694935]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.528990, 46.809436]); // Date range for September 19, 2019 const startDate = '2019-09-19'; const endDate = '2019-09-20'; // Function to mask clouds using QA60 band function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and( qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // Get Sentinel-2 collection let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point1) .map(maskClouds); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point2) .map(maskClouds); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Point 1 Images: ${size1}, Point 2 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("No images found for one or both points."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composite const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // Calculate brightness (mean of visible bands) as proxy for milkiness // Milky water appears brighter/whiter const brightness1Image = img1.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()); const brightness2Image = img2.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()); // Check pixel counts const count1 = await brightness1Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point1, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean').getInfo(); const count2 = await brightness2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point2, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - Point 1: ${count1}, Point 2: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Get brightness values const brightness1 = await brightness1Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point1, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean').getInfo(); const brightness2 = await brightness2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point2, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean').getInfo(); console.log(`Brightness Point 1: ${brightness1}, Point 2: ${brightness2}`); if (brightness1 === null || brightness2 === null || isNaN(brightness1) || isNaN(brightness2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare: milkier water = higher brightness if (brightness1 > brightness2) { console.log("Point 1 is more milky (brighter)."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Point 2 is more milky or equal."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
